points: same deterministic 256 identities from frozen locator cache

representation.encoded_baseline: official TAPNext++ lin_proj plus image_pos_emb, frozen Gate D frame0 errors
representation.conv_frame0: official TAPNext++ lin_proj output before image_pos_emb at frame 0
representation.conv_max8: maximum normalized cosine over GT-visible conv-only exact-point features from frames 0-7
representation.conv_mean8: normalized mean of GT-visible conv-only exact-point features from frames 0-7
representation.conv_logsumexp8: logsumexp(10*cosine)/10 over GT-visible conv-only exact-point features

decision_order: ALLOW_POSITION_FREE_MULTIVIEW_LOCATOR if conv_max8 candidate and multiview incremental gates pass
ALLOW_POSITION_FREE_SINGLE_VIEW_LOCATOR if conv_frame0 candidate gate passes
